turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks for contacting Acme.  How may I help you today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I'm looking at a pair of boots on your website and the size I want says unavailable.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Oh, I'm sorry to hear that.  Let me see what I can do

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I may be able to help with this, may I ask your full name and account ID before we begin?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Norman Bouchard

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I might not be able to find the item for you, but I should still be able to let our purchasing department know what it is that you were looking for

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I don't have my account ID

turns.speaker: system_action
turns.text: Account has been pulled up for Norman Bouchard.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Ah, that shouldn't be a problem, I can see your account now, Mr. Bouchard

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I'm looking for the Michael Kors boots in a size 9

turns.speaker: system_action
turns.text: The Michael Kors boots Size 9 has been notified.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Okay, I have notified our purchasing department about the missing items, and hopefully they can do a better job next time.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Ok thank you.  Will they notify me if they are in stock?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'm sorry we couldn't have that item available for you.  They should notify you when it is in stock, or, if you'd prefer I can put in a back-order for you?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, please put it on backorder

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: If I place the order for you now, it would ship automatically as soon as we get it in, if that's okay

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: That is fine.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Excellent, if you would like to use the same credit card that we already have on file, I can do that for you right now

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes please

turns.speaker: system_action
turns.text: A purchase of Michael Kors boots, size 9 was made.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Okay, your order is placed, and it should be on its way to you as soon as possible.  Is there anything else I can help you with today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: That's everything.  Thanks for your help.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: You're very welcome.  Have a great day
